sourcePolicy.provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India — National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF)
sourcePolicy.access: Official 2025 report PDF opened directly over public HTTPS; manually inspected the Engineering top-100 table. The separate NIRF ranking HTML returned 403 and was not used. No authentication, automated collection, access-control bypass or DCS data was used.
sourcePolicy.factualUse: The repository provider register allows link/citation for public NIRF ranking outputs; this batch records only rank, category, year and exact source row, without copying report prose, charts, scores or institution-submitted DCS information.
sourcePolicy.redistribution: No explicit bulk report/reuse license was identified for the PDF. These are limited internal research candidates, not a bulk re-publication; do not enable public display until the reviewer verifies the source, institution match and intended-use policy. Link and attribution must accompany any approved claim.
sourcePolicy.review: All 25 remain RESEARCHED_UNREVIEWED candidates. No human decision was simulated.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Education, Government of India — National Institutional Ranking Framework
sources.reuseConditions: Public India Rankings output may be linked and cited under the existing provider register. No explicit bulk reuse license was identified for the report. Only individual rank/category/year facts and source row locators are retained; no DCS submissions, report prose, charts, score values or PDF copy are stored. Review intended-use policy before public display.
